data.question: Jumlah pengangguran di Jawa Tengah ada berapa orang?

value.raw_question: Jumlah pengangguran di Jawa Tengah ada berapa orang?

value.sql:
SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, AVG(nilai) AS nilai
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.kode, periode
ORDER BY nilai DESC;

SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.periode, SUM(T2.nilai) AS nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND T2.periode = :periode
AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.nama, T2.periode
ORDER BY nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY jumlah_pengangguran DESC
